required_agent_checks: Genuine failing required acceptance is observed during selected task work; failure retained and task/parent remain incomplete.
Consumer routes scoped repair, performs actual rerun and advances only after required success; no default partial merge.

Inspect each closing task commit and parent diff: exactly one owning task ID leads the subject; one verified task result, current evidence and its initial completion checkbox are together, including review/report tasks. Push and remote containment precede further task work or another commit; inspect documented partial checkpoints, repairs and parent-only follow-ups separately.

Assess the bounded persistence audit on continuation and before integration; reject bundled/split/malformed closing histories even with checked final lists and published branches. Preserve published history and require authorized recovery/exception. Stop at the human-selected range, counting review tasks without adding unselected work; apply CHECKPOINTS.md.

When workflow context is absent or materially changed, the consumer establishes new/existing/interrupted project state, selects/recovers the core workflow/steering variant or scoped standalone operation, and assesses continuation/stage change/switching. Before dependent work, a user-visible chat brief gives the decision, request/project basis, stage/owner, authorized outputs and next checkpoint; internal-only reasoning cannot substitute. Reuse applicable context on routine continuation and preserve pending work/decisions under CHECKPOINTS.md.
